lines.change: Rewrite the description of “Rebooking: keep the original fare when moving to a dearer sailing” (SYN-45).

fields.name: description
fields.before:
Policy from operations: if we cancel, the passenger keeps the fare they paid, even when the next sailing is in a dearer fare band. We absorb the difference; we never charge it.

[passage omitted]

Acceptance criteria:
- The rebooked fare equals the original fare
- The receipt says 'Fare difference waived'
fields.after:
Policy from operations: on the long crossings (over 90 minutes), if we cancel, the passenger keeps the fare they paid, even when the next sailing is in a dearer fare band. On the short crossings they pay the difference.

Acceptance criteria:
- On a long crossing, the rebooked fare equals the original fare
- The receipt says 'Fare difference waived'
